title: Airlines in Europe slash thousands of flights as Iran war cuts jet fuel supplies
summary: The soaring cost of jet fuel is forcing European airlines to cancel tens of thousands of flights, while energy authorities warned of a possible jet fuel shortage if supplies aren't replenished soon.
contentText:
The soaring cost of jet fuel is forcing European airlines to cancel tens of thousands of flights, while energy authorities warned of a possible jet fuel shortage if supplies aren't replenished soon.

(Image credit: Isabelle Souriment + Hans Lucas)
